pages.title: Eat My Junk
pages.text: Eat My Junk runs for about two minutes before it repeats, which makes it the longest song in Skitchin'. It plays in Miami, the eleventh race, an 8.7-mile course whose password is PALMS.

pages.title: Playing with friends
pages.text: In Skitchin', two players can race at once on a split screen, take turns or go head to head, and up to eight can play a tournament. The game calls these modes Solo Skitch, Skitch 'n Switch, Grand Slam Jam and Double Trouble.
